D. Northeastern Illinois Planning Commission (NIPC)
Metropolitan Clearinghouse Review
The Northeastern Illinois Planning Commission has reviewed this proposed improvement in accordance with "Metropolitan Clearinghouse" procedures utilized by that agency. A copy of the Northeastern Illinois Planning Commission review, dated May 22, 1974. is contained in Appendix "C". Also included in this Appendix is a copy of the review of this proposed improvement by the Interstate Planning Committee; dated May 22, 1974.
